source_notes: World Athletics member federations (~214). Gender share ~50 percent under Paris 2024 parity. Saaty: flagship broadcast; stadium cost high.
World Aquatics member federations (~209). Olympic swimming gender-balanced. High aquatics-venue cost.
World Skate national federations compiled from public IF listings (~100+; 116 recorded). Youth urban sport; park/street cheaper than a stadium.
ISA member nations (~100+). Ocean or wave venue lighter than a full stadium.
WDSF members (~90+). Paris 2024: one mens and one womens breaking event. Minimal dedicated venue.
WKF members (~198). Tokyo 2020: eight medal events gender-balanced. Combat hall not a new stadium.
ICC Full plus Associate members (108). Womens professional footprint still below mens (42 percent proxy). High outfield cost; strong Subcontinent TV.
WSF members (~120+). Typically paired mens/womens draws. Indoor courts; limited global TV.
IFAF member nations (~70+). LA28 lists mens and womens flag football. US broadcast pull; overlay on existing pitches.
